This [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[630 freighter|630]] '''freighter''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] operated by the newly formed [[Kota's squad|squad]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. It transported the squad from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] near the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]].
